title: Fix Port 8080 Conflict: Satelink API vs Paperclip
description:
## Problem

SENTINEL reported (via [SAT-41](/SAT/issues/SAT-41)) that the Satelink API is **DOWN/Unreachable** at `localhost:8080` due to a port conflict with Paperclip.

The Paperclip API URL is configured as `http://127.0.0.1:8080` — the same port the Satelink Express backend is expected to bind to. This creates a conflict where one service prevents the other from starting.

## Root Cause Hypothesis

Either:
1. Paperclip is running on 8080, preventing Satelink backend from binding
2. Satelink backend startup is failing for an unrelated reason and 8080 is vacant
3. Both are started and competing for the port

## Investigation Steps

1. Run `lsof -i :8080` to identify what is holding port 8080
2. Check Satelink backend startup logs (`src/`, Express server entry point)
3. If Paperclip holds 8080: change Satelink local dev port to **8081** in `.env` / `src/config/`
4. Verify `DATABASE_URL`, `REDIS_URL`, `JWT_SECRET` are set — missing env causes silent startup failure
5. Start the backend and confirm `/health` returns 200
6. Update `agent/memory/SENTINEL_STATUS.md` and clear any outstanding ALERTS.md entry

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Port conflict identified and root cause document

   Body: { "nodeId": "...", "metrics": { "latency": ms, "uptime": seconds } }
   Nodes offline more than 5 minutes are marked inactive and stop earning.
5. How Earnings Work:
   50% of platform revenue distributed to active nodes each epoch.
   Your share \= (your ops ÷ total network ops) × operator pool.
   Higher NETS reputation score \= higher share.
6. How to Claim:
   GET https://rpc.satelink.network/api/nodes/:nodeId/earnings — check balance
   POST https://rpc.satelink.network/api/nodes/:nodeId/claim — claim to your wallet
   48-day claim window
